subject: pharmacology
title: Anticholinergics in Parkinsonism and Cognitive Enhancers: Trihexyphenidyl, Donepezil, Memantine

steps.tx: **Trihexyphenidyl** (benzhexol) restores the striatal dopamine acetylcholine seesaw from the other side: when dopamine falls, cholinergic interneurons overact, and central anticholinergic blockade damps tremor (more than bradykinesia) in younger patients. Its price is the full anticholinergic catalogue: dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision, confusion and memory failure, which is why age over 70 or any cognitive impairment effectively bans the class in modern practice.
steps.say: Trihexyphenidyl helps young tremor and harms old brains; age writes the prescription more than tremor does.

left.title: Where anticholinergics fit
points: Younger patients with tremor dominant disease
Drug induced parkinsonism adjunct with caution
Sialorrhoea reduction as a side benefit
When levodopa response is incomplete for tremor

right.title: Where they are banned in practice
points: Age over 70 or any cognitive impairment
Prostatic urinary retention and glaucoma
Constipation and ileus prone patients
Dementia with Lewy bodies: confusion catastrophe

steps.tx: When nigral dopamine falls, striatal cholinergic interneurons become relatively overactive. **Trihexyphenidyl**, or benzhexol, blocks those central cholinergic signals and damps tremor more effectively than it damps bradykinesia, which is why it was offered to younger patients. The cost is the whole anticholinergic list: dry mouth, constipation, urinary retention, blurred vision, confusion and failing memory. Age over 70, or cognitive impairment at any age, is enough to avoid the class in current practice. The tremor is not, by itself, a reason to prescribe it.
steps.say: Trihexyphenidyl blocks overactive cholinergic interneurons in the striatum and helps tremor in younger patients more than it helps slowness. Dry mouth, constipation, retention, blurred vision, confusion and memory loss come with it. Past 70, or if memory is already poor, the drug is left unused even when tremor is obvious.

vis.alt: A striatal balance diagram shows dopamine reduced and acetylcholine increased, with trihexyphenidyl damping the cholinergic side.
vis.caption: The striatal seesaw tips toward acetylcholine when dopamine falls, and trihexyphenidyl is drawn pushing back from the cholinergic side. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Drug induced parkinsonism from dopamine blockers is managed first by removing or reducing the blocker, with anticholinergics or amantadine as bridges, never by reflex levodopa which fights the antipsychotic's purpose. Anticholinergics also treat **acute dystonia** dramatically: intravenous procyclidine or benztropine unwinds an oculogyric crisis within minutes, a resuscitation room pearl quite separate from their weak chronic tremor role.
steps.say: Acute dystonia melts under intravenous anticholinergics; chronic drug induced parkinsonism wants the blocker removed.

nodes.label: Dopamine blocker started: antipsychotic or metoclopramide
Review the blocker: reduce, switch or cover briefly

steps.tx: Crossing to dementia pharmacology, **donepezil** reversibly inhibits acetylcholinesterase, raising synaptic acetylcholine in a cortex losing cholinergic neurons in Alzheimer disease, with modest symptomatic benefit on cognition and function and no disease modification. Rivastigmine (also inhibiting butyrylcholinesterase, with a patch formulation) and galantamine (plus nicotinic modulation) share the class. Cholinergic adverse effects run in reverse of anticholinergic teaching: nausea, diarrhoea, bradycardia, syncope, vivid dreams and muscle cramps.
steps.say: Donepezil tops up a fading cholinergic cortex; expect gut and pulse to feel it first.

vis.alt: Brain PET scans in Alzheimer disease showing regional hypometabolism
vis.caption: Alzheimer disease imaging, the condition cholinesterase inhibitors and memantine symptomatically support.

steps.tx: **Memantine** antagonises the NMDA receptor with moderate affinity and a fast off rate, blocking pathological glutamate excitotoxicity while sparing physiological learning signals, which suits moderate to severe Alzheimer disease alone or combined with donepezil. It is generally well tolerated (dizziness and occasional confusion), renally dosed, and examinations love it as the anti ketamine: same receptor, opposite kinetic manners, entirely different therapeutic universe.
steps.say: Memantine guards the NMDA gate politely where ketamine bars it theatrically; kinetics make the difference.

left.title: Memantine profile
points: Moderate affinity, voltage dependent NMDA blockade
Moderate to severe Alzheimer disease
Combines with donepezil in later stages
Renal dose adjustment, dizziness the main toll

right.title: NMDA contrast set
points: Ketamine: high affinity, dissociative anaesthesia
Amantadine: weak NMDA blockade in Parkinson therapy
Memantine: engineered for chronic tolerability
All three answer NMDA questions in examinations

steps.tx: **Galantamine** adds nicotinic allosteric modulation to acetylcholinesterase inhibition and is metabolised by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4, making poor metabolisers and inhibitor partners its prescribing footnote. Across the class, initiation means slow titration over weeks to let the gut adapt, dosing with food, and vigilance where beta blockers, bradycardia or peptic ulcer disease already live, because vagotonic cholinergic excess respects none of those territories. Donepezil's long half life forgives a missed dose and permits once daily timing chosen around dreams.
steps.say: Titrate cholinesterase inhibitors slowly with food, and respect hearts and stomachs already on beta blockers.

nodes.label: Increase to 10 mg after 4 to 6 weeks
Cognition, function, pulse and weight reviewed
Continue while benefit and tolerability balance

steps.tx: The **cholinergic seesaw** unifies this lesson and much of the examination paper: anticholinergics worsen dementia and relieve parkinsonian tremor, cholinesterase inhibitors aid dementia and can worsen tremor or provoke bradycardia, and dementia with Lewy bodies, exquisitely cholinergic deficient, benefits most from cholinesterase inhibitors while suffering most from dopamine blockers and anticholinergics. One transmitter, four quadrants, endless vignettes built from the crossings.
steps.say: Cholinergic up helps memory and hurts tremor; down helps tremor and hurts memory. Lewy body patients live at the extreme.

left.title: Cholinergic enhancement
points: Agents: donepezil, rivastigmine, galantamine
Helps Alzheimer and Lewy body cognition
Costs: bradycardia, gut upset, vivid dreams
Can worsen tremor modestly

right.title: Cholinergic blockade
points: Agents: trihexyphenidyl, procyclidine, benztropine
Helps tremor and acute dystonia
Costs: confusion, retention, constipation, dry mouth
Effectively banned in cognitive impairment

steps.tx: Parkinson disease dementia and dementia with Lewy bodies borrow the Alzheimer shelf because cholinergic loss is severer there: rivastigmine and donepezil carry the evidence and licences, memantine assists selected cases, while antipsychotics are rationed to quetiapine or clozapine under specialist care, given neuroleptic sensitivity reactions that can be fatal. An **anticholinergic burden** audit across bladder, bowel, sleep and pain drugs often improves cognition more than any enhancer adds.
steps.say: In Lewy body disease, subtract anticholinergics before adding enhancers, and ration antipsychotics to specialists.

nodes.label: Anticholinergic burden audit of the whole drug list
Remove bladder, sleep and pain anticholinergics
Psychosis: quetiapine or clozapine, specialist led

steps.tx: **Deprescribing hygiene** closes the lesson: every anticholinergic started in a young tremor patient carries a planned old age exit, every cholinesterase inhibitor carries pulse and syncope review, memantine carries renal arithmetic, and all of them carry an annual ask whether benefit persists. Monitored trials of halving or stopping donepezil in advanced disease are legitimate medicine, not abandonment, when goals of care have shifted toward comfort.
steps.say: Start every one of these drugs with its review date and exit criteria already written.

left.title: Starting rules
points: Trihexyphenidyl: young, cognitively intact, tremor dominant
Donepezil: baseline pulse, ECG where syncope history
Memantine: renal function sets the dose
All: indication and review date documented

right.title: Stopping rules
points: Anticholinergics out before cognitive impairment arrives
Cholinesterase inhibitors trialled off in advanced disease
Comfort goals govern late stage decisions
Withdrawal effects monitored on any cessation
